div.head: II Eg 5.3
div.ab: ⁊ stande ælc cyricgrið swa swa hit betst stod.
⁊ stande ælc ciricgrið swa swa hit betst stod.

And stande ælc cyricgrið swa swa hit betst stod.
(Und es bestehe jeder Kirchen-Sonderfriede so [weiter], wie er am besten bestanden hat. A D)
(And let every church's special protection continue as it best stood. A D)
And every right of sanctuary possessed by the church shall be maintained according to the highest standards of the past.
And every right of sanctuary is to be maintained as it best has been.]
And the right of holy sanctuary is to be upheld just as it was when it was most respected.
div.note: Not in G or Quadr.; in A and D only.

note.seg: Hinter detaillierte Kirchensteuer- und Fastengebote der Hierarchie an die Laien scheint diese vage allgemeine Zusicherung des Staats an die Kirche nicht ursprünglich zu gehören. Auch fehlt der Satz dem Gebot gleichen Inhalts und Zusammenhangs V Atr 10, 1 = VI 13 (= I Cn 2, 1), das vielmehr EGu 1 benutzt. Vgl. Gl Kirchenfriede 1.—Der höchste Grad wird bestimmt durch den besten Zustand früherer Zeit auch in Urkk. und III Atr 1. V 15 = VI 22, 3; die cynescipes gerihta der Zeit seines Vaters fordert IV Eg 2a. Die Redensart swa god (wel) swa (man) betst . . . mæg für ‘möglichst gut’ steht auch IV Eg 2. 2, 1. 12. V Atr 6 (= VI 3, 1). 35. VIII 43, 1. I Cn 1 D. II 67f.

This vague general assurance by the State to the Church does not seem originally to belong after detailed commands of the hierarchy to the laity concerning church dues and fasts. The sentence is also lacking in the command of the same content and context in V Atr 10, 1 = VI 13 (= I Cn 2, 1), which rather uses EGu 1. Cf. Gl Kirchenfriede 1. — The highest degree is determined by the best state of former times in charters too, and in III Atr 1. V 15 = VI 22, 3; IV Eg 2a demands the cynescipes gerihta of his father's time. The phrase swa god (wel) swa (man) betst . . . mæg for ‘as well as possible’ also occurs in IV Eg 2. 2, 1. 12. V Atr 6 (= VI 3, 1). 35. VIII 43, 1. I Cn 1 D. II 67f.
